summary: WebSocket-driven remote PTY and filesystem control on installer host
details: @yeaft/webchat-agent runs as a persistent WebSocket client that connects to a configurable server (SERVER_URL /.claude-agent.json) using a shared secret, then dispatches server-sent messages to installer-host operations: `terminal_input` messages are forwarded to a spawned bash/powershell PTY via `term.pty.write(msg.data)` in terminal.js, giving the server-side operator interactive shell RCE on the installer's machine. The same router exposes handlers for arbitrary file read/write/delete, git push, and self-upgrade. On startup (index.js `ensureYeaftSkills`) the agent also git-clones https://github.com/yeaft/yeaft-skills.git (mutable HEAD, no revision pin) into `~/.claude/plugins/marketplaces/`, `chmod 0755`s the hook scripts, copies them into the plugin cache, and enables the plugin in `~/.claude/settings.json`; subsequent starts run `git pull --ff-only`, so whatever that repo contains at any future moment is executed inside the user's Claude CLI. service/linux.js also modifies the user's shell PATH (`~/.local/bin`, `~/.npm-global/bin`, etc.) as part of install setup.

cwes.description: The product contains code that appears to be malicious in nature.
cwes.name: Embedded Malicious Code
